form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. text-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.

form:FormGroup.label: Table
form:FormGroup.helpText: Table or embedded query whose selected row decides which data is shown. Choose Any to follow a selection in any of them.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Component whose selected row decides the data shown, or Any.

form:FormGroup.label: Stream Id Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: Column that holds the stream ID of the selected row. Default is __stream_id__.

form:FormGroup.label: Part No Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: Column that holds the part number (starting at 1) of the selected row. Optional.

form:FormGroup.label: Record No Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: Column that holds the record number (starting at 1) of the selected row. Not needed if the line from and line to columns are set. Default is __event_id__.

form:FormGroup.label: Line From Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: Column that holds the line number where the text to highlight starts. Used with the other line and column settings.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Highlight start line. Used with the other position columns.

form:FormGroup.label: Col From Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: Column that holds the column (character) number where the text to highlight starts.

form:FormGroup.label: Line To Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: Column that holds the line number where the text to highlight ends. Used with the other line and column settings.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Highlight end line. Used with the other position columns.

form:FormGroup.label: Col To Column
form:FormGroup.helpText: Column that holds the column (character) number where the text to highlight ends.

form:FormGroup.label: Pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: Pipeline used to process the data before it is shown. Optional, but required if you only have permission to view data through a pipeline.
